test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘CAUGHT’ is written as ‘EYWEJR’ and ‘ENGINE’ is written as ‘GLIGPC’. How will ‘WORKER’ be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70ac350310de9d00beabc3d8861da373ba45ccd31fbe15fa1f48f91cb727075b.png] 

The logic followed in the given code language:

‘CAUGHT’ is written as ‘EYWEJR’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/820ae78e75bc20bacb1826a5b7ee991fdacb840e714d65fa53eeae72bc4c0339.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed8018320711a01fc51e3430d13eaa43dab42e1317495793a7a4802f56d93259.png] 

‘ENGINE’ is written as ‘GLIGPC’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75ee1687e3597897d06cd525a5462c139e0c39793f627d92216145d0fa5f1ea9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31d50b00c14694c7bd394241393b4395e19065e1321fa7959c8c6f7159d938db.png] 

Similarly, ‘WORKER’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41a2ec908812c85d1ca161e6473c9ba1580277e47b6c97b5b1d9824034f48341.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/716cfbd9176f5bd18c37c4b7b648b10f90f5bc00a7ebed985b3d8ff6af08407f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**YMTIGP**".
